name: gdt
description: Gaëtan's dev tooling — a growing collection of personal development-workflow skills. sdd: an autonomous spec-driven-development pipeline (worktree → specs → plan → adversarial review → subagent-driven execution). memory-optimization: a subagent fan-out that fact-checks a Claude Code memory store against the live system, then consolidates it and rebuilds MEMORY.md. worktree-sweep: fans a diagnostics backlog (clippy lints, compiler warnings) out to one worktree-isolated agent per rule family, lands the fixes as a linear stack, verifies, and cleans up.
